name: 30-continuation-redirect-cross-origin
description: A VALIDATED same-origin `next` answers 302 with a cross-origin Location: the poll seam suppresses automatic redirect-following, and the foreign Location is Terminal(invalid_continuation). {{NEXT:1}} substitutes same-origin, so the pre-poll validation PASSES and the second poll seam call is made (contrast fixture 26, where no request reaches the URL at all) — the redirect answer is where the per-hop rule bites. What tier 2 verifies is the per-hop refusal DECISION (the driver classifies the scripted Location through the shipped predicate) and the loop's response: the continuation terminal, the socket explicitly closed, and no further seam calls. That the adapter's HTTP client makes zero requests to the refused URL is below the poll seam and owned by Layer-1 adapter conformance; the Location host is literal, never substituted, and never served. Kills follow-cross-origin-redirect.
